note: Phase timing transcribes the unchanged source tracks. Voice phase.start/peak/end are sampled guidance lines, not the complete movement rhythm. Audio may need lead-in or suppression when longer than a motion phase; never warp the animation to fit speech.

w-dead-bug.countingSemantics: One controlled extension and return of one opposite arm/leg pair counts as one rep. Alternate pairs; the 8-second clip contains two reps, one per pair. Default reps=10 means 10 total alternating reps, 5 per pair, not 10 per side.
w-dead-bug.movementSides: alternating-cross-body: first pair right arm + left leg, then left arm + right leg at second 4; reset at second 8

h-chair-step-up.countingSemantics: One complete ascent and descent led by one leg counts as one rep. Alternate the lead leg; 8 seconds contains two reps, right then left. Default reps=10 means 10 total reps, 5 led by each leg, not 10 per side.

h-db-curl.countingSemantics: One arm curl and controlled lowering counts as one rep. Alternate arms; 8 seconds contains two reps, right then left. Default reps=12 means 12 total alternating reps, 6 per arm, not 12 per side.

glute-max-A.countingSemantics: One lift and return on the support leg counts as one rep. Default reps=10 is per side; complete all 10 on the left support leg, then cue a side change. The 8-second clip contains two left-support reps and no side change; repeat five loops before switching for the default dose. Opposite-side media is not produced.

s-frog.countingSemantics: Timed mobility/stretching: do not count the 8-second demonstration as an 8-second static hold. One loop shows one slow backward rock and return; default seconds=40 spans five demonstration loops. No sustained peak hold is encoded.

h-catcow-quad.countingSemantics: One cat-to-cow-and-neutral cycle lasts 4 seconds; the 8-second loop contains two cycles. Default seconds=40 is timed movement, 10 cycles at the demonstration cadence, not 40 repetitions.
